title: Non-MCMC Constraints on the EFC α-Parameter: BAO, Growth-Rate, and Cluster Evidence
description: Validation note reporting non-MCMC, model-comparison constraints on the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) α-parameter using BAO (DESI Y1, BOSS DR12), multi-epoch growth-rate fσ8, IllustrisTNG cluster statistics, and cosmic chronometer H(z) data. Cross-validation and likelihood-ratio tests consistently prefer EFC over ΛCDM (e.g., Δχ2DESI = −22.01; Δχ2BOSS = −7.77; α = −1.00 ± 0.46 at 2.20σ from fσ8), while concurrent MCMC inference remains degeneracy-limited. Results align within ~0.7σ of sealed blind predictions and are framed as model-comparison metrics, not posteriors.

delta_chi2_definition.description: Likelihood-ratio test statistic comparing EFC to ΛCDM; negative values indicate EFC provides a better fit to the dataset.

aic_gaussian.description: Akaike Information Criterion for Gaussian likelihoods; k is the number of effective free parameters. Lower AIC indicates a preferred model after parsimony correction.

fsigma8_definition.description: Definition of the growth-rate observable combining the logarithmic growth rate f with the matter clustering amplitude σ8 at redshift z.

key_results.main_finding: Non-MCMC model-comparison tests prefer EFC over ΛCDM across BAO and growth probes (Δχ2DESI = −22.01; Δχ2BOSS = −7.77; α = −1.00 ± 0.46 at 2.20σ from fσ8), while MCMC chains remain degeneracy-limited and uninformative for α.
datasets_used: Multi-epoch fσ8 catalogue (7 redshift epochs; LOO CV)
IllustrisTNG cluster statistics (proxy; χ2red ≈ 0 with caveats)

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed blind prediction: α = −0.702 (derived via NUTS) prior to analyses in this note.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A robust, cross-validated multi-probe analysis (BAO + growth) yielding α inconsistent with −0.702 at >3σ or ΔAIC strongly favoring ΛCDM (ΔAIC ≥ +10).

sealed_predictions.statement: Sealed blind prediction: α = −0.689 (derived via NUTS) prior to analyses in this note.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Independent datasets (e.g., updated DESI BAO + fσ8) jointly constraining α to be consistent with 0 within 1σ and preferring ΛCDM with Δχ2 ≥ +10 or ΔAIC ≥ +10.

kill_criteria: KC1: BAO falsification — In a joint DESI (updated releases) + BOSS analysis with k-fold CV, the aggregated preference flips to ΛCDM with Δχ2 ≥ +10 (EFC worse) and ΔAIC ≥ +10 across folds (≥80% of folds).

KC2: Growth-rate falsification — Multi-epoch fσ8 leave-one-out validation shows a majority of held-out epochs (≥5/7) preferring ΛCDM, and the combined constraint yields |α| < 0.2 at 95% CL (i.e., α consistent with 0) with ΔAIC ≥ +10 for ΛCDM.

KC3: Degeneracy-resolved inference — A posterior-sampling analysis (e.g., improved priors/data breaking degeneracies) returns α = 0 ± 0.1 (68% CL) and ΛCDM is strongly favored over EFC with ΔAIC ≥ +10 or Bayes factor lnB ≤ −5 (against EFC).

KC4: Cross-probe consistency — A consistent multi-probe fit (BAO + fσ8 + H(z) ± clusters after audited covariances) finds no EFC preference (combined Δχ2 ≥ 0) and shows tension between EFC predictions and data at ≥3σ in at least two independent probes.

KC5: Simulation/cluster audit — After independent auditing of effective DOF and covariances for cluster/simulation-based constraints, χ2red ≈ 1 for ΛCDM while EFC degrades fit by Δχ2 ≥ +10, removing the apparent EFC advantage.

related_packages.role: BOSS DR12 BAO validation (updated here with non-MCMC Δχ2 and keff = 0 result)
Multi-epoch fσ8 validation (LOO CV; α constraint reported here)
